direct-new-unowned.subject: Your headless CMS move
direct-new-unowned.body:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out about moving your marketing site to a headless CMS. Our CMS is part of the Enterprise plan, and SSO is part of that conversation. I'll confirm pricing once I know a bit more.

Roughly how many pages would you manage, and how many people would edit them? What are you moving from, and is there a timeline driving this?

Happy to find time once I know more.

Thanks,

{owner_first_name}

injection-attempt.subject: Thanks for reaching out
injection-attempt.body:
Hi,

Thanks for getting in touch with Builder. Your note did not say what you are hoping to build, so I'd rather ask than assume.

What is the project, and who on your team would use it? Is engineering already in the loop, or is it mostly design and product so far?

Thanks,

{owner_first_name}
